AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food food frying food? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food food frying food.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food food frying food.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food food frying food.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food food frying food.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Domestic Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Domestic Hygiene.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Domestic Hygiene.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Domestic Hygiene.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Domestic Hygiene.

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Hygiene.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Hygiene.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Hygiene.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Hygiene.

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Making Tacking Stitches? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Making Tacking Stitches.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Making Tacking Stitches.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Making Tacking Stitches.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Making Tacking Stitches.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Fruits? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Fruits.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Fruits.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Fruits.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.

16. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

17. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

18. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Balanced Meal.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Balanced Meal.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Balanced Meal.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Balanced Meal.

20. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fuel Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fuel Conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fuel Conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fuel Conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fuel Conservation.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

24. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Fuel Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of Domestic Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Balanced Meal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

31. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food food frying food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

32. In three clear sentences, explain Personal Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
